repository_change_acceptance.claim: The sealed repository change satisfies its frozen per-Task acceptance contract.
repository_change_acceptance.model_review: Findings may identify discrepancies; zero findings leave the review unverified.

repository_material.binding: Exact Task, work revision, run, dispatch, attempt and sealed ArtifactSet.

repository_capture.producer: agentosd repository dispatcher and return collector
repository_capture.operation: Capture real bytes and full lineage through the Artifact Authority; seal before evidence handoff.

repository_evidence.binding: Evidence is verified against its sealed Artifact and the exact Task lineage. Model text is not independent evidence.

local_retention.policy: Preserve governed Artifact bytes and provenance in the configured local store; this profile schedules no automatic deletion or external export.

repository_command_intent.content: Exact command id, criterion, executable, ordered argv, working directory, inherited environment names, environment overrides, expected exit, time and output budget from the frozen contract.

repository_command_receipt.content: Real supervised process result, observed exit or safe failure, captured stdout/stderr and truncation status, bound to the sealed command intent.

repository_command_capture.operation: Execute the frozen command under process supervision and seal the actual outcome; a failed process is not converted to a passed receipt.

repository_checker_input.content: Owner-validated sealed Claim, ArtifactSet, Context snapshot, repository manifests, patch, command receipts, independent evidence and exact Verification request binding.

repository_checker_output.content: Criterion outcome and limitations bound to the real request, run, checker profile, execution and source lineage; missing evidence remains unverified.

repository_checker_tools.scope_and_tests: Read sealed independent receipts without re-executing acceptance commands.
repository_checker_tools.review: One supervised Codex read-only turn after durable Verification Start; unknown delivery is held without replay.

repository_checker_egress.review_prompt: Frozen acceptance contract and selected repository material are sent to the explicitly configured model provider.

repository_checker_deployment.declaration: Compiled implementation and validated configuration, not a claim that a native probe has run.
repository_checker_deployment.reuse: Immutable checker identity may be reused across Tasks; each request and output retains its own Task lineage.

repository_checker_capture.operation: Seal actual checker deployment or output through the same Artifact Authority and independently validate the producer, role, request, run, profile and source binding.

repository_checker_detail.content: Structured criterion evaluation with observed limitations and evidence references.

repository_checker_tool_receipt.content: Actual native probe or tool execution and delivery outcome.

repository_checker_model_receipt.content: Actual model identity, native thread and turn, output binding and reported usage when available.

repository_checker_cost_receipt.content: Observed cost metadata only; absent provider cost is never fabricated.

founder_supporting_material.content: Canonical FounderSupportingMaterial protobuf: authenticated author, role, explicit user body, coverage, current Verdict scope and original Artifact lineage.

founder_supporting_material_capture.operation: Stage and seal only after the current Task and Verification binding and Founder allowlist have been validated by their real owners; exact material replay creates no new Artifact.
